test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

Frequent
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Constant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term** "Frequent" **implies something that happens or appears often or at regular intervals.(अक्सर, बार-बार, नियमित)
 
• **Constant - **happening or existing all the time or again and again. (नियत)</l
